title: Putting It All Together: Advanced Patterns
description: Combine Server Components, parallel routes, and intercepting routes to build a photo gallery with a modal.

slides.title: The Photo Gallery Blueprint 🖼️
slides.content:
# Integrating Three Advanced Features

We'll build:

* **Server Component** gallery page (`app/gallery/page.js`) that fetches photos from a database.
* **Parallel Route** slot for a sidebar with recent comments (`@sidebar`).
* **Intercepted Route** for clicking a photo to open a modal overlay (`(..)photo/[id]`).

All within the same layout, each independent and streaming.

slides.title: The Layout (app/gallery/layout.js)
slides.content: Defines the slots: children (the main gallery) and sidebar.

slides.title: The Gallery Page (app/gallery/page.js)
slides.content: Server Component that fetches photos and renders links.

slides.title: The Intercepted Modal (app/gallery/(..)photo/[id]/page.js)
slides.content: Intercepts navigation to /photo/[id] from the gallery and renders a modal.

slides.title: The Full Photo Page (app/photo/[id]/page.js)
slides.content: When accessed directly or on refresh.

slides.title: The Parallel Sidebar Slot (app/gallery/@sidebar/page.js)

quizData.question: In the photo gallery, what ensures that clicking a photo from the gallery opens a modal, but refreshing the page shows the full photo?

options.text: The combination of an intercepted route (`(..)photo/[id]`) for navigation and the actual page route (`photo/[id]`) for direct access
A special `modal` prop on the Link

quizData.explanation: Next.js intelligently routes to the intercepted page on client‑side navigation from the gallery, and to the actual page on hard navigation, giving a seamless modal experience.

slides.title: Architecture Decisions 🏛️
slides.content:
# When to Use Each Pattern

* **Server Components**: Always default. Switch to Client Component only when you need interactivity.
* **Streaming/Suspense**: Whenever a component fetches its own data.
* **Parallel Routes**: When a single view needs multiple independent sections.
* **Intercepting Routes**: When you want modal/overlay patterns with shareable URLs.

Mixing them creates seamless, high‑performance experiences.

slides.title: The Future is Streamed 🌊
slides.content: These patterns aren't just for complex apps. Even a simple blog can benefit from streaming comments and using parallel routes for author info. Start simple, then sprinkle in advanced patterns as needed.
